method: Per-person spend before tax & tip. main/side/dessert/drink = typical à-la-carte price of one item (for sit-down places, side = an appetizer shared by 2; for pizza chains, one person = 3 of 8 slices of a large and shared sides/2-liters split by 3; for cafés, main = one drink). The app averages 5 usual orders: main · main+side · main+drink · main+side+drink · main+side+dessert+drink. 'est' marks categories no source priced, filled with a typical value for that kind of restaurant. Prices vary by location; most sources are third-party price trackers.
